criteria.description: Playable first-person 3D range with depth-separated targets
Both movement axes and solid wall blocking
View-based aiming follows visible line of sight
Opaque geometry blocks shots without removing the valid target
Distinct targets count once including the moving target
Timed reload refills and blocks intermediate fire
Victory requires three different target hits
Restart restores magazine, targets and round state
Target silhouettes, crosshair, occluding wall, target status, ammo and reload progress remain legible at rest and in motion.
Movement/look/fire/reload/restart controls and the three-target goal are visible and match tested actions.
Miss, hit, duplicate/blocked shot, empty magazine, reload and victory have unambiguous visible state changes or rejection cues.
Neon training-arena style is coherent without hiding targets or UI; foreground/world depth and essential controls fit both viewports.
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated main-loop gameplay
